title: General Bragmur escort (Coldain shawl finale)
summary: Escort General Bragmur across Iceclad and defend the Coldain shawl ceremony.
overview: Escort General Bragmur across Iceclad and defend the Coldain shawl ceremony.

sections.title: Encounter guide
bullets: Complete the general’s required preparations before beginning the march. Follow Bragmur through his route rather than racing ahead.
Wolves and giants ambush the escort at fixed waypoints. Pick them up quickly so they do not kill the general.
The later attacks include Kvarid and Vjorik. Hold a reserve for these named attackers while keeping the escort safe.
Remain through the final ceremony and follow the general’s dialogue to complete the quest sequence.

notes: Reviewed against quest source only; encounter behavior, database tuning and availability have not been verified in a live zone. Tactical advice is inferred from the scripted mechanics.
